changes: New explicit dose: eight whole raw shell eggs replace 400 g ready-cooked peeled egg, without a weight equivalence. Count-based source products preserve exact purchase quantities; boiling/peeling has unknown served mass. Ground Five Spice and frozen coriander cook in the retained broth; tofu oil and side liquid are served. Active pot loading, checks, egg cooling/peeling and turning are separately scheduled.
recipes.content_review: Hårdkokta hela ägg och fläskkarré bräseras i karamell, soja och Five Spice; skild från wokat äggris, friterad omelett i soppa och basilikatofu.
